adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the recurring-event deletion sweep is now inside the new `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop. The sweep still iterates `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` and for each `updBooking` it does `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, meaning it only deletes the first calendar reference per updated booking. Because the recurring sweep block is inside the per-reference loop, it will run once per calendar reference of the canceled booking, causing duplicate `deleteEvent` calls for the same `updBooking` refs (likely failing on subsequent passes). Also, the sweep is limited to `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, so it does not address calendars referenced via other hosts’ credentials when multiple calendar references exist.
